v7_full.mechanism: Memoize a class-local setattr handler per attribute name. On the first assignment, execute the existing semantic dispatch to classify the name, synthesize a handler for stable paths, certify that the handler preserves the same branch semantics, cache it, and invoke it directly on subsequent assignments.
source_visible_preconditions: repeated assignments reuse attribute names
dispatch depends predominantly on model class metadata
common declared-field writes are stable after class construction

v7_full.mechanism: Use memoized handlers only for branches whose future behavior is class-stable; certify branch eligibility on miss and recover to the original full dispatcher for unstable dynamic-extra or descriptor cases.
source_visible_preconditions: most benchmark assignments target declared fields/private attributes
some extra-allow paths are state dependent

v7_full.mechanism: Reduce repeated dispatch by precomputing a per-class set of simple assignable fields for models without frozen/validate-assignment complications and execute a direct declared-field write when the name is in that reduced set; otherwise use the original dispatcher.
source_visible_preconditions: model fields and configuration are available at class completion
many assignments are ordinary declared fields

v7_full.mechanism: Cache only negative/non-special classifications for declared fields after certifying that the class is mutable and assignment validation is disabled; recover to the original dispatcher for every unclassified name.
source_visible_preconditions: ordinary mutable fields dominate some tests

v7_full.mechanism: Memoize specialized handlers for private attributes, cached properties, validate-assignment fields, and ordinary fields separately; handler identity is certified from immutable class metadata before insertion.
source_visible_preconditions: benchmark explicitly exercises private/cached/validate paths

v7_full.mechanism: At class completion compile a compact dispatch table from class vars, private attributes, fields, descriptors and config flags, reducing runtime classification to one dictionary lookup plus handler execution.

v7_no_library.mechanism: Use a direct private-name branch before general valid-field processing and specialize simple private attributes without descriptors.

v7_no_library.mechanism: Factor ordinary field writes, private writes, and cached-property writes into module-level callables to reduce repeated inline branch bodies and enable cheaper function references, without caching name-to-handler decisions.

v7_no_library.mechanism: Attempt the ordinary declared-field write under a narrow static predicate and recover to the original dispatcher otherwise; no persistent learned abstraction or handler memoization is introduced.
